name: Figma (Framelink)
err:
in _run
    raise RuntimeError(f"could not connect: {_leaf(e2)} (server/discover also failed: {discover_error})"
RuntimeError: could not connect: MCPError: Connection closed (server/discover also failed: DiscoverFailed: MCPError: Connection closed; initialize on the same connection: MCPError: Connection closed)
Either FIGMA_API_KEY or FIGMA_OAUTH_TOKEN is required (via CLI argument or .env file)
